gloss: to cancel; to call off; to abandon (a plan)

definitions.gloss: to cancel, to call off, to abandon
definitions.explanation: To decide not to go through with a plan, event, or action that was previously intended. Implies a deliberate decision to stop before something has begun.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}を{取|と}りやめた。
{雨|あめ}のため{試合|しあい}を{取|と}りやめることにした。
examples.english: We decided to call off the game because of rain.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}の{都合|つごう}で{計画|けいかく}を{取|と}りやめざるを{得|え}なかった。
examples.english: We had no choice but to abandon the plan due to budget constraints.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{計画|けいかく}を{取|と}りやめる (abandon a plan)
・{旅行|りょこう}を{取|と}りやめる (cancel a trip)
・{試合|しあい}を{取|と}りやめる (call off a game)
・{予定|よてい}を{取|と}りやめる (cancel plans)

USAGE NOTES:
Similar to {中止|ちゅうし}する but {取|と}りやめる emphasizes the decision-making process of choosing not to proceed. {中止|ちゅうし}する is more neutral and can refer to stopping something already in progress, while {取|と}りやめる typically refers to canceling before the event begins. Often written with hiragana やめる rather than kanji {止|や}める.
